During the [[Clone Wars]], [[Jedi General]]s [[Mace Windu]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]] undertook a '''mission''' to search the wreckage of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Endurance]]'' for any survivors after it crashed on [[Vanqor]]. Unbeknownst to the [[Jedi]], however, the [[bounty hunter]]s who had [[Sabotage of the Endurance|sabotaged]] the ship had visited the wreckage first. The bounty hunters killed surviving clone troopers, leaving the corpses of many slain clones in the wreckage. Additionally, they took three [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] officers who had survived the crash hostage and left a booby trap that left Skywalker and Windu trapped in the wreckage. Skywalker's [[astromech droid]], [[R2-D2]], was then forced to evade the bounty hunters and [[gundark]]s roaming the crash site in an attempt to call for help and prevent the hunters from finding the Jedi in the ruins of the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]]. R2 was eventually forced to go all the way to [[Coruscant]] in Windu's [[Mace Windu's Jedi fighter|Jedi starfighter]] for help after the hunters, unaware of the identity of their opponent, destroyed the starfighter's long-range communications. [[Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon]] and Skywalker's [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] returned to Vanqor with the [[droid]] and the [[clone trooper]]s of the [[104th Battalion]] to rescue the trapped Jedi before the ''Endurance''{{'s}} wreckage completely collapsed.<ref name="R2" />
